absent: Area split merge copy and tree update algorithms and their lock ordering.
Page fault entry path, retry protocol and copy on write resolution steps.
Maple tree API semantics and read copy update traversal guarantees.
Anonymous and file reverse map maintenance and NUMA migration decisions.
Scheduler cache, membarrier, KSM, hugetlb and reclaim interactions.
Architecture context contents, IOMMU data and notifier subscription behavior.

findings.text: A virtual area describes one contiguous half open interval inside an address space, recording bounds, owning space pointer, page protection, dual legacy and converted flag storage, anonymous offset split across low and optional high halves, reverse map chain and object, operations table, file offset with backing file and private datum, plus optional swap, NUMA, balancing, lock sequence, reference count, shared interval node, name, userfault and tracking state.

An address space aggregates a maple tree of areas, mmap bases and task size, top level table pointer, structural and user counts, concurrency identifiers, table accounting and area count, table spinlock and mmap semaphore, global swapped linkage, futex state, high water and current counters for total locked pinned data exec and stack use, default flags, write protect sequence, argument lock with code data break stack and argument bounds, auxiliary vector, RSS counters, binary format, architecture context, flag bitmap and optional teardown hugetlb KSM reclaim identifier and accelerator state ending in flexible storage.
Descriptor flags are held as a private fixed width bitmap wrapper whose capacity comes from a separate count constant and whose storage is reached only through dedicated accessor helpers.

Area lookup state is a thin wrapper around a maple cursor bound to one address space tree, constructible at a start address through a macro initializer or an init helper that associates tree and index.
Reclaim walker queue state pairs an intrusive list head of address spaces with a spinlock serializing that queue.
A special mapping descriptor names the region and selects between a null terminated backing page vector and a fault resolver, with optional remap and close hooks for lifetime transitions.

Each area covers start inclusive to end exclusive within its owning space. A private file area may appear in both file tree and anonymous list after copy on write, a shared file area only in the file tree, and an anonymous stack break or private area with no file only in an anonymous list.

Structural count includes user count as one unit and frees the descriptor at zero, while user count tracks userspace plus temporary holders and on reaching zero releases one structural reference, potentially freeing the descriptor.

Processor and identifier bitmaps live in trailing variable storage after the fixed descriptor in order current mask then allowed mask then identifier mask, each derived by offset arithmetic from the descriptor base, with a static initializer zeroing the combined static prefix.

Per area sequence may only be stored while holding mmap lock for write with readers excluded, may be read reliably while holding mmap lock in either mode or while exclusion is active or multiple references exist, and may be sampled unreliably under retention alone for pessimistic bailout.

Anonymous chain linkage requires both mmap lock and page table lock, the anonymous object pointer requires page table lock, the anonymous name pointer requires mmap lock, and the owning space pointer and reference count permit unstable read copy update observation.

Page table lock guards tables and associated counters including the shared huge entry where present, mmap semaphore guards tree and most descriptor mutation with layout tuned to separate hot fields, argument lock guards program break stack and argument bounds, a global lock guards swapped linkage, and the global sequence uses release on increment under write lock and acquire on read without it.

Area attachment and locking is encoded in one count: zero detached and not incrementable, one attached unlocked or write locked distinguished by sequence equality, small values above one read locked, and a large exclusion base marking detaching or write locking where further reader increments are forbidden and the value only decreases until completion.

Global lock sequence starts at zero and advances on each write lock and unlock of mmap lock, so odd values denote write held and even values denote released, with increments acting as release of area locks and reads participating in area read acquisition.
Helpers convert a legacy flag word into converted representation from an empty value, and overwrite, fetch as bitmap or word, or masked update the descriptor flag bitmap.

Reclaim membership helpers either initialize list and bitmap and mark use by setting all bitmap bits when enabled, or compile to no operation stubs when disabled, with add remove and migrate operations in both modes.

Identifier allocation reserves per processor storage and initializes context with failure reporting, destroy releases storage, and size reports combined mask sizes when enabled and zero otherwise, while scheduler allocation reserves per processor time state and delegates initialization, collapsing to immediate success and empty destroy when disabled.
Processor mask helpers clear the trailing mask at the flexible base and return pointers to current, allowed and identifier bitmaps by successive offset steps.

Policy selection yields the area policy when NUMA support is present and null otherwise, maple configuration requests allocation range plus external locking plus read copy update behavior, and static identifier reservation is either twice a processor mask or zero depending on support.

Fault result is a bitwise unsigned type with values OOM 0x1, SIGBUS 0x2, MAJOR 0x4, HWPOISON 0x10, HWPOISON_LARGE 0x20, SIGSEGV 0x40, NOPAGE 0x100, LOCKED 0x200, RETRY 0x400, FALLBACK 0x800, DONE_COW 0x1000, NEEDDSYNC 0x2000, COMPLETED 0x4000 and index mask 0x0f0000 for bits sixteen to nineteen, with index set shifting left by sixteen and get shifting right by sixteen then masking four bits, and error aggregate combining OOM SIGBUS SIGSEGV HWPOISON HWPOISON_LARGE and FALLBACK.

Descriptor flag capacity is sixty four bits, static identifier storage is two processor masks when enabled else zero, and flush reasons in order are task switch, remote shootdown, local shootdown, local mm shootdown, remote send IPI and remote wrong CPU.

Sequence reuse after overflow is permitted and may only force occasional slow path use, unstable readers must tolerate stale owning pointer sequence and count values, write protect sequencing must be held while write protecting for later copy on write such as table copy, and batched unmap or protection none moves require TLB flush accounting.

Swap, no MMU region, NUMA policy and balancing, per area locking, high anon half, anonymous name, userfault and PFN tracking members exist only under their options, as do membarrier, compat bases, notifier, huge, KSM, reclaim, identifier and accelerator descriptor members, and canonical owner may change only when current holder leaves while the new holder resides in the space under allocation lock.
A special mapping must provide either a non null terminated page vector or a fault resolver, with the resolver taking precedence and pages unchecked when present.
